blocks.text: THE ELIJAH SAINTS— In this Script we will unveil some astonishing visions and real life occurrences as the Holy Spirit projected things to come! And as the gift of prophecy opens the view into the future! In this very moment and short period of time ahead God is uniting the elect into one body! As Paul said, the Lord Himself shall descend and we shall be caught up with the Lord in the air! — “We believe this atmosphere and time dimension, in a moment in the twinkling of an eye we will be with Jesus in the eternal heavenlies!” — Elijah gives us a good illustration of the Translation! II Kings 2:11- 12, And it came to pass, as they still went, on and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven. And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces. — Enoch was also translated out of this realm into eternity. (Heb. 11:5) — So shall the dead in Christ and us likewise! “Except for the birth of Christ we are living in the most important century in 6000 years or since the creation of Adam and Eve!”

THE MIGHTY APOSTLE FORESEES PARADISE— After we reveal some Bible experiences we will tell of some amazing ones in our era of time! — Now let’s read — II Cor. 12:2-4, I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such a one caught up to the third heaven. And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) How that he has caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter. — The Scriptures say Paul was in the desert for about 14 years. Evidently this is where he was caught up. But Paul said he did not want to glory himself in it so he couched it, and some of the things he could not utter. — “Evidently part of it has to do with incredible things including the Translation and the 7 Thunders! As now they are uttering their secrets and prophecies to the true church!”

THE SPIRIT IN THE WHIRLWIND— A real true life experience that absolutely came to pass word for word. God called me into a protracted fast and I entered the ministry approaching 1961. After many meetings in, then my home state California, I then crossed the U.S. states for various crusades and the Lord gave tremendous miracles! I was crossing the state of Arizona near the border on the way back home. At this moment I told my family the Lord told me to stop the car and walk out into the desert. I will never forget it; after walking a distance I set down under what they call a Joshua tree. (I thought at the time it looked like a Juniper tree) — The spirit was swarming all over me! Anyway the Holy Spirit whirlwind came towards me blowing the grass and leaves and positioned itself! And the spirit of the Lord said He was going to give me a chosen group of partners to stand with me! He told me I would go into Calif. then back to Arizona and be ministering in a building! Today, known as the Pyramidical Capstone Sanctuary. At the time, we had no idea of what type it would be until later. It was a startling occurrence!

CONTINUING— After a short period, I went back to the car and crossed into California. I wondered how all of this would take place! A little afterwards, I was sitting by a cabin close to the house and the spirit was blowing in the trees very mysterious like! And again He spoke and said, go get your names. I had forgotten all about them that I had collected in my crusades and etc. Then later He moved on me to begin to write the Scripts. I’ve already told about the angel of the Lord and how it occurred! This occurred in the autumn just before 1967 and my first writing went forth. — Also the Lord appeared in dreams and different ways for other people to write me. — “Shortly afterwards I moved to Arizona and everything the Lord said has come to pass! What a thrilling and joyous visitation and prophecy! — This is just given in brief. You can also read about my calling in Creative Miracles book. — This occurred about 10 months after the death of the prophet that we will speak of. And we will list some interesting facts. I’m in no way trying to associate or take his place. We each have a different ministry! He sparked Revival 1946-48, but since his death groups have made it difficult to keep things in their perspective.

WM. BRANHAM— The Heavenly Vision — Quote: I think most of you remember how I said I had always been afraid to die lest I should meet the Lord and He should not be pleased with me as I had failed Him so many times. Well, I had been thinking of that one morning as I lay in bed and suddenly I was caught up in a most peculiar vision. I say it was peculiar for I have had thousands of visions and not once did I seem to leave my body. But there I was caught up; and I looked back to see my wife, and I saw my body lying there beside her. Then I found myself in the most beautiful place I have ever seen. It was a paradise. I saw throngs of the most beautiful and happiest people I have ever seen. They all looked so young — about 18 to 21 years of age. There was not a gray hair or a wrinkle or any deformity amongst them. The young women all had hair down to their waists, and the young men were so handsome and strong. Oh, how they welcomed me. They hugged me and called me their darling brother, and kept telling me how glad they were to see me. As I wondered who all those folks were, one beside me said. “They are your people.” I was so astonished I asked, “Are all these Branhams?” He said, “No, they are your converts.” He then pointed me to one lady and said, “See that young lady that you were admiring a moment ago. She was 90 years old when you won her to the Lord.” I said, “Oh my, and to think this is what I was afraid of.” The man said, “We are resting here while waiting for the coming of the Lord.” I replied, “I want to see Him.” He said, “You can’t see Him just yet; but He is coming soon, and when He does He will come to you first, and you will; be judged according to the gospel you have preached, and we will be your subjects.” I said, “Do you mean I am responsible for all these?” He said, “Every one. You were born a leader.” I asked him, “Will every one be responsible? What about Saint Paul?” He answered me, “He will be responsible for his day.” “Well,” I said, “I’ve preached the same Gospel that Paul preached.” And the multitude cried, “We’re resting on that.”

NOTE: And as I was reading this above with mine it started to rain out of nowhere. It was glowing and full of light and running down the car windshield in streams and beautiful sparkles! Then I saw flashes of lightning in front of me in the west. But the rain came first. It was actually like shekinah glory that David saw! — Ps. 72:6, “He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.” — The rain lasted for just a few moments! We know we are in the former and latter rain now! — I’ve seen this at Capstone like this Scripture. (Read Zech. 10:1)

CONTINUING— This Scripture will bear out the youth of our bodies! At Jesus resurrection the angel was sitting upon the rock. It called him a young man, yet he was created millions of eons of years ago! (Mark 16:5) — Note: I had a strange event that occurred in my life one night. I found myself in a heavenly place not of earth. “And I saw great rolls of glory rolling across heaven as if a rug was rolling out.” (beautiful) — It let me know there are real dimensions in the spirit and glories of God!

BEAUTIFUL CITIES— Jesus, you are more than this who created all the beauty around us and the awesome heavens, universes and stars! One day beside the Holy City we will see beautiful cities and places of such wonder of thy creation! Besides the stars and heavens you have created magnificent things that we have not seen! “Beautiful colors of icy wonder like, of spiritual fires and lights of such beauty, and creatures likewise of such formation that we will be amazed and startled by such a creator of so many more things that can not be mentioned and are without number! Such glorious spiritual colors never seen or beheld by man’s eyes!” — Surely and definitely many marvelous mysteries await us that love Him! Literally more than trillions of creations will He unveil to His chosen! — After this was revealed to me I wondered how to unveil it and then I remembered God’s Word that could have to do with the millennium. (Luke 19:16- 19) But also may involve what was told. Nevertheless the elect are in for many surprises that eye hath not seen!
